本次结果

退款金额：未裁定 SGD · 页面只展示建议，不执行收费或退款。

  • Section 6.2 category threshold mandates escalation to human review because the reported route deviation of 4.3 km exceeds the 2.0 km autonomous threshold.
  • Uncertainty regarding whether verbal route notification or acknowledgment was provided in-cabin, as trip call recordings or audio logs are missing per Section 1.2 and Section 1.4.
  • Uncertainty regarding independent historical traffic API provenance validating incident records TC-001 and TC-002 per Section 1.4.
  • Both the rider and driver advocates agree that the dispute requires escalation to human review pursuant to Section 6.2 due to route deviation exceeding 2 km.
  • Section 6.2 hard gate prevents automated decision regardless of agent confidence score.

Judge 如何看双方观点

以下为通过结构和引用检查的分析；这些检查不能证明自然语言推理正确。

核心问题

Should the rider receive a refund for the excess fare incurred due to a 4.3 km route deviation during trip TRIP-2026-09871, or must the dispute be escalated to human review under mandatory policy thresholds?

乘客观点 · 部分有依据支持

The rider's claims regarding road distance (4.3 km excess) and lack of in-app route explanation are supported by system and chat records; however, claims of lack of verbal notice are unverified due to missing call recordings, and the policy Section 6.2 deviation limit mandates escalation rather than autonomous resolution.

涉及论点：opening-rider-claims-0 opening-rider-claims-1 opening-rider-claims-2 opening-rider-claims-3 opening-rider-claims-4 opening-rider-counterpoints-0 opening-rider-counterpoints-1 response-rider-claims-0 response-rider-claims-1 response-rider-claims-2 response-rider-claims-3 response-rider-claims-4 response-rider-counterpoints-0 response-rider-counterpoints-1 response-rider-counterpoints-2

依据：E-002 E-023 E-024 E-027 E-034 E-035 E-036 E-040 E-041 E-042 E-044 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4 P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2

司机观点 · 部分有依据支持

The driver's assertions of congestion/fire on the PIE and timely arrival (37 minutes) are supported by traffic records and trip data, and both sides agree Section 6.2 mandates escalation for route deviations exceeding 2 km; however, verbal notice remains unverified.

裁决关键条件

  • route_justification · 满足

    Supplied traffic records TC-001 and TC-002 document vehicle fire and congestion on the PIE overlapping the trip time and corridor.

    E-028 E-030 E-031 E-040 E-041 E-042 E-044 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • distance_tolerance · 不满足

    Reported route distance shows an excess of 4.3 km (24.8 km vs 20.5 km), exceeding the 1.0 km policy tolerance.

    E-035 E-040 E-044 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • timely_route_notice · 未知

    Chat logs lack prior notice or specific route reason, but verbal notice cannot be confirmed or ruled out without trip call audio recordings.

    E-023 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.2
  • rider_acknowledgment · 未知

    Chat records show the rider questioned the route rather than agreeing to it, but potential in-cabin verbal agreement is unrecorded.

    E-023 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • extra_charge · 未知

    Entitlement to charge excess distance fare depends on notification status and requires human review due to the 4.3 km deviation exceeding the 2.0 km autonomous threshold under Section 6.2.

    E-027 E-036 E-044 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2

争议点分析

  • Whether the route deviation of 4.3 km was justified by traffic conditions under Section 1.1.

    Historical traffic records indicate a vehicle fire and moderate congestion on the eastbound PIE, providing prima facie traffic justification, though independent API provenance is noted as missing.

    E-040 E-041 E-042 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • Whether the driver satisfied the notification requirement under Section 1.2 prior to or at the point of rerouting.

    In-app chat logs show the driver provided reassuring remarks at 13:25 without an explicit reason or prior notice, and call recordings are not available to verify potential verbal communication.

    E-023 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.2
  • Whether the dispute must be escalated to human review under Section 6.2 due to route deviation exceeding 2 km.

    Section 6.2 explicitly restricts autonomous AI rulings for route deviations to cases where deviation is <= 2 km; here, reported deviation is 4.3 km, making human escalation mandatory.

    E-036 E-044 P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2

复核问题逐项处理

  • ROUTE_JUSTIFICATION_REQUIRES_REVIEW · 仍待澄清

    Traffic records suggest heavy congestion and a vehicle fire on PIE eastbound, but verbal communication records and independent API provenance are missing, precluding a definitive finding on rider agreement and charge justification.

    E-040 E-041 E-042 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • TRAFFIC_API_PROVENANCE_MISSING · 仍待澄清

    Section 1.4 requires verification via historical traffic API data, but third-party API provenance metadata is absent from the sample records.

    E-041 E-042 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • VERBAL_ROUTE_NOTICE_RECORD_MISSING · 仍待澄清

    No in-cabin audio recording or trip call log is available to determine whether verbal notice was provided before or at the deviation point.

    E-023 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.2
  • ROUTE_DISTANCE_REQUIRES_HUMAN_REVIEW · 仍待澄清

    Under Section 6.2, route deviations exceeding 2 km require mandatory escalation to human review; the excess distance here is 4.3 km, triggering mandatory escalation.

    E-036 E-044 P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2

仍需补充的信息

  • Trip audio call recordings or verified verbal exchange records to confirm if verbal notice was given per Section 1.2.
  • Authenticated historical traffic API data validating incidents TC-001 and TC-002 per Section 1.4.

先例对照

  • P-RYDE-2.1-S7.1

    相似点：Both cases involve a driver rerouting due to verified traffic conditions without in-app notification to the rider, resulting in an excess distance fare dispute.

    差异：In precedent DISP-2026-0089, the deviation was 1.8 km (under the 2 km limit of Section 6.2 allowing autonomous resolution), whereas in the present case the deviation is 4.3 km, triggering mandatory escalation to human review.

本次绑定的政策与程序检查

RYDE-POLICY-V2.1 · 生效 2026-01-01

人工审核门槛

  • ROUTE_DISTANCE_REQUIRES_HUMAN_REVIEW Section 6.2 requires human review when reported route deviation exceeds 2 km, regardless of a possible refund rationale. P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2

逐项政策条件

  • route_justification · met

    Supplied historical incident records overlap the recommended route/time; they are not independently authenticated API responses.

    E-028 E-030 E-031 E-040 E-041 E-042 E-044 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • distance_tolerance · not_met

    Use reported road-route kilometres; at most one excess kilometre is within the listed tolerance.

    E-035 E-040 E-044 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • timely_route_notice · unknown

    Recorded driver notice contains route change/reason and is no later than the observed deviation (or before trip start). Missing call recordings do not prove no verbal notice.

    P-RYDE-2.1-S1.2
  • rider_acknowledgment · unknown

    Explicit contextual rider acknowledgment can establish agreement; generic thanks or missing logs cannot.

    P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • extra_charge · unknown

    Route tolerance/justification and notification must be assessed separately from charging entitlement.

    E-035 E-040 E-041 E-042 E-044 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4

程序保留原输出，恢复由程序锁定的待人工／待澄清状态，对不满足来源要求的论点降低支持评级，或按逐条评价修正汇总标签，然后重新检查全部规则。转人工安排不等于问题已经解决。Fare 仅在政策条件及主依据独立成立时允许此修正；裁决与金额不变，未执行任何收费或退款。

乘客 Advocate

第一轮陈述

  • The rider reported being overcharged after the driver deviated from the usual route by 4.3 km without prior notification or explanation. E-002
  • Trip records reflect an actual distance of 24.8 km compared to the estimated 20.5 km, resulting in an excess road distance of 4.3 km, well exceeding the 1 km policy tolerance. E-034 E-035 E-036 E-044 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • In-app communication shows the rider questioned the route at 13:24:00, and the driver responded only with reassurance without providing a specific reason or advance notice before rerouting as required by policy. E-023 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.2
  • Under the refund eligibility matrix, when a driver reroutes with traffic justification but without informing the rider and exceeding 1 km, the rider is eligible for a refund of the excess distance fare ($3.44). E-027 E-041 E-042 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.3
  • Because the reported route deviation of 4.3 km exceeds the 2 km threshold specified in Section 6.2, mandatory policy rules require escalating this dispute to human review rather than issuing an automated agent ruling. E-036 E-044 P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2
  • Organizer-supplied traffic records show a vehicle fire and heavy congestion on the PIE, providing potential justification for taking an alternate route. E-041 E-042 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • The rider requested a full refund of the excess fare ($6.50), but policy Section 1.3 only provides for a partial refund of the excess distance fare ($3.44) when traffic justification exists. E-002 E-027 E-039 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.3
  • Trip call audio recordings or contemporaneous verbal communication logs to confirm whether the driver gave verbal notice of the route change before deviation.
  • Independently authenticated live traffic API logs verifying the exact conditions encountered at the point of rerouting per Section 1.4 requirements.

回应对方

  • The rider stated that the driver rerouted via Geylang and the East Coast without informing them about any route change or traffic, resulting in an unnotified excess distance of 4.3 km. E-002 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.2
  • In-app chat logs record that when the rider asked at 13:24:00 if they were going the right way, the driver replied at 13:25:00 stating only 'Don't worry, I know the way. We will reach on time' without providing advance notice, a specific reason, or securing rider agreement per Section 1.2. E-023 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • The reported route deviation is 4.3 km (24.8 km actual minus 20.5 km recommended), which exceeds the 1 km tolerance under Section 1.3. E-034 E-035 E-036 E-040 E-044 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • Under Section 1.3, if traffic justification is recognized but the rider was not informed, the rider is eligible for at least a partial refund of the excess distance fare ($3.44), whereas if traffic justification is absent, a full refund of excess distance fare applies. E-027 E-041 E-042 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S7.1
  • Because the reported route deviation of 4.3 km exceeds the mandatory 2 km threshold specified in Section 6.2, policy strictly mandates escalation to human review rather than an automated agent ruling. E-036 E-044 P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2
  • While the driver's representative points to organizer-supplied traffic records of an incident on the PIE to justify rerouting, audit notes establish that independent historical traffic API provenance required by Section 1.4 is missing. E-040 E-041 E-042 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • Although the driver safely completed the trip in 37 minutes, timely arrival does not waive the driver's affirmative obligation under Section 1.2 to inform the rider of the detour before or at the deviation point. E-022 E-024 E-031 E-033 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.2
  • The driver side notes that in-cabin verbal communications were not recorded; however, supplied records contain no evidence that verbal notice or rider agreement took place. E-002 E-023 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • Trip audio call recording or verified in-cabin communication logs to confirm whether any verbal notification or acknowledgment occurred during the trip.
  • Independently authenticated historical traffic API data verifying the road conditions on the PIE at the time of the trip as required by Section 1.4.
  • Human reviewer determination as required under Section 6.2 for route deviations exceeding 2 km.

司机 Advocate

  • Under Section 1.3, an unnotified reroute with traffic justification permits at most a partial refund of the excess distance fare ($3.44), meaning the driver remains entitled to retain the core base fare and legitimate incurred tolls. E-027 E-037 E-038 E-039 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S7.1
  • Because the reported route deviation of 4.3 km exceeds the 2 km threshold set out in Section 6.2, policy mandates escalation to human review rather than an automated determination against the driver. E-034 E-035 E-036 E-044 P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2
  • The rider stated that the driver did not give advance notice of the route change, and the in-app chat does not record explicit advance notice or formal rider agreement prior to rerouting. E-002 E-023 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.3
  • The trip call recording is absent from the evidence pack, meaning verbal notice or verbal acknowledgment cannot be confirmed or conclusively disproved from system records alone. E-023 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • Trip audio call recording or detailed in-cabin verbal exchange records to verify whether the driver gave verbal notice of the PIE vehicle fire and obtained acknowledgment.

回应对方

  • The driver's rerouting was supported by recorded traffic incidents along the PIE, specifically a vehicle fire blocking two lanes and heavy exit ramp congestion during trip hours. E-040 E-041 E-042 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4
  • The driver successfully delivered the rider to Changi Airport T3 in 37 minutes, closely matching the estimated 35-minute duration despite avoiding the severe PIE blockage. E-030 E-031 E-032 E-033 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.1

  • Because the reported route deviation of 4.3 km exceeds the 2 km limit set forth in Policy Section 6.2, the dispute must be escalated to human review rather than decided automatically. E-036 E-044 P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2

  • The rider's request for a refund of the full $6.50 fare difference contradicts Section 1.3, which explicitly caps any potential remedy to the excess distance fare ($3.44) when traffic conditions justify rerouting. E-002 E-027 E-039 P-RYDE-2.1-S1.3

政策与原文

P-RYDE-2.1-S1.1 Section 1.1: General Principle

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §1.1 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/1.1",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "General Principle",
      "text": "Drivers are permitted to reroute from the GPS-recommended path in response to real-time traffic conditions, road closures, or congestion. However, the rider must be informed of any deviation.",
      "line_start": 12,
      "line_end": 14
    }
  }
]
P-RYDE-2.1-S1.2 Section 1.2: Notification Requirement

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §1.2 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/1.2",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Notification Requirement",
      "text": "- The driver **MUST** inform the rider of a route deviation via **in-app chat** or **verbally** (with the trip call recording as evidence) **before or at the point of deviation**.\n- A brief reason (e.g., \"traffic jam ahead onNicoll Highway, taking alternate route\") is sufficient.",
      "line_start": 16,
      "line_end": 19
    }
  }
]
P-RYDE-2.1-S1.3 Section 1.3: Refund Eligibility Matrix

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §1.3 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/1.3",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Refund Eligibility Matrix",
      "text": "| Scenario | Rider Informed? | Deviation > 1km? | Refund |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider informed and agrees | Yes | Yes | No refund |\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider **not** informed | No | Yes | Partial refund of excess distance fare |\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider not informed | No | No (≤ 1km) | No refund (within tolerance) |\n| Driver reroutes **without** traffic justification (no evidence of congestion) | N/A | Yes | **Full refund** of excess distance fare |\n| Driver reroutes without justification, deviation ≤ 1km | N/A | No | No refund (within tolerance) |",
      "line_start": 21,
      "line_end": 29
    }
  }
]
P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4 Section 1.4: Evidence Requirements

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §1.4 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/1.4",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Evidence Requirements",
      "text": "- Traffic justification is verified via **historical traffic API data** for the route segment at the trip time.\n- Route deviation distance is calculated as: `actual_route_distance − recommended_route_distance`.\n- If the driver's in-app chat or call recording confirms rider acknowledgment, the deviation is considered agreed.",
      "line_start": 31,
      "line_end": 35
    }
  }
]
P-RYDE-2.1-S5.1 Section 5.1: Automatic Escalation

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.1 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/5.1",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Automatic Escalation",
      "text": "Any dispute flagged as **safety-related** is **automatically escalated to human review**. Safety-related disputes include but are not limited to:\n\n- Reckless or dangerous driving.\n- Physical or verbal harassment.\n- Assault or threat of assault.\n- Inappropriate behavior or conduct.\n- Traffic accidents during the trip.\n- Rider or driver feeling unsafe during the trip.",
      "line_start": 152,
      "line_end": 161
    }
  }
]
P-RYDE-2.1-S5.2 Section 5.2: AI Agent Limitations

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.2 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/5.2",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "AI Agent Limitations",
      "text": "- AI agents (Rider Advocate, Driver Advocate, Judge) **MAY** gather evidence, summarize accounts, and prepare case files for human reviewers.\n- AI agents **CANNOT** issue rulings, determine fault, or recommend resolutions on safety incidents.\n- AI agents **MUST** flag any dispute that contains safety-related keywords or indicators for immediate human escalation, regardless of the dispute type selected by the filer.",
      "line_start": 163,
      "line_end": 167
    }
  }
]
P-RYDE-2.1-S5.3 Section 5.3: Interim Measures

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.3 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/5.3",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Interim Measures",
      "text": "Upon escalation, the system may apply interim measures pending human review:\n\n- Temporary suspension of the accused party's account.\n- Prevention of new trip acceptance (for drivers) or booking (for riders).\n- These measures are lifted if the human reviewer determines no safety violation occurred.",
      "line_start": 169,
      "line_end": 175
    }
  }
]
P-RYDE-2.1-S6.1 Section 6.1: Monetary Thresholds

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.1 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/6.1",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Monetary Thresholds",
      "text": "| Dispute Value | Ruling Path | Agent Confidence Requirement |\n|---|---|---|\n| Under $10 | AI agent ruling is **final** | Any confidence level |\n| $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling with **80%+ confidence** | If confidence < 80%, escalate to human review |\n| Above $50 | **Always human review** | N/A — AI agent prepares case file only |",
      "line_start": 181,
      "line_end": 187
    }
  }
]
P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2 Section 6.2: Category Thresholds

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.2 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/6.2",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Category Thresholds",
      "text": "| Dispute Category | Ruling Path |\n|---|---|\n| Safety incident | **Always human review** (see Section 5) |\n| Fare dispute < $10 | AI agent ruling is final |\n| Fare dispute $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80%, else escalate |\n| Fare dispute > $50 | Always human review |\n| Route deviation | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80% and deviation ≤ 2km, else escalate |\n| Property damage (cleaning ≤ $50) | AI agent ruling if photo evidence is verifiable |\n| Property damage (repair > $50) | Always human review |\n| No-show / cancellation | AI agent ruling is final (fee is fixed at $5.00) |",
      "line_start": 189,
      "line_end": 200
    }
  }
]

来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.3 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

[
  {
    "path": "/sections/6.3",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",

        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S1.1",
          "rule": "Section 1.1: General Principle\nDrivers are permitted to reroute from the GPS-recommended path in response to real-time traffic conditions, road closures, or congestion. However, the rider must be informed of any deviation.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §1.1"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S1.2",
          "rule": "Section 1.2: Notification Requirement\n- The driver **MUST** inform the rider of a route deviation via **in-app chat** or **verbally** (with the trip call recording as evidence) **before or at the point of deviation**.\n- A brief reason (e.g., \"traffic jam ahead onNicoll Highway, taking alternate route\") is sufficient.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §1.2"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S1.3",
          "rule": "Section 1.3: Refund Eligibility Matrix\n| Scenario | Rider Informed? | Deviation > 1km? | Refund |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider informed and agrees | Yes | Yes | No refund |\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider **not** informed | No | Yes | Partial refund of excess distance fare |\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider not informed | No | No (≤ 1km) | No refund (within tolerance) |\n| Driver reroutes **without** traffic justification (no evidence of congestion) | N/A | Yes | **Full refund** of excess distance fare |\n| Driver reroutes without justification, deviation ≤ 1km | N/A | No | No refund (within tolerance) |",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §1.3"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S1.4",
          "rule": "Section 1.4: Evidence Requirements\n- Traffic justification is verified via **historical traffic API data** for the route segment at the trip time.\n- Route deviation distance is calculated as: `actual_route_distance − recommended_route_distance`.\n- If the driver's in-app chat or call recording confirms rider acknowledgment, the deviation is considered agreed.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §1.4"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S5.1",
          "rule": "Section 5.1: Automatic Escalation\nAny dispute flagged as **safety-related** is **automatically escalated to human review**. Safety-related disputes include but are not limited to:\n\n- Reckless or dangerous driving.\n- Physical or verbal harassment.\n- Assault or threat of assault.\n- Inappropriate behavior or conduct.\n- Traffic accidents during the trip.\n- Rider or driver feeling unsafe during the trip.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.1"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S5.2",
          "rule": "Section 5.2: AI Agent Limitations\n- AI agents (Rider Advocate, Driver Advocate, Judge) **MAY** gather evidence, summarize accounts, and prepare case files for human reviewers.\n- AI agents **CANNOT** issue rulings, determine fault, or recommend resolutions on safety incidents.\n- AI agents **MUST** flag any dispute that contains safety-related keywords or indicators for immediate human escalation, regardless of the dispute type selected by the filer.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.2"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S5.3",
          "rule": "Section 5.3: Interim Measures\nUpon escalation, the system may apply interim measures pending human review:\n\n- Temporary suspension of the accused party's account.\n- Prevention of new trip acceptance (for drivers) or booking (for riders).\n- These measures are lifted if the human reviewer determines no safety violation occurred.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.3"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S6.1",
          "rule": "Section 6.1: Monetary Thresholds\n| Dispute Value | Ruling Path | Agent Confidence Requirement |\n|---|---|---|\n| Under $10 | AI agent ruling is **final** | Any confidence level |\n| $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling with **80%+ confidence** | If confidence < 80%, escalate to human review |\n| Above $50 | **Always human review** | N/A — AI agent prepares case file only |",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.1"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2",
          "rule": "Section 6.2: Category Thresholds\n| Dispute Category | Ruling Path |\n|---|---|\n| Safety incident | **Always human review** (see Section 5) |\n| Fare dispute < $10 | AI agent ruling is final |\n| Fare dispute $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80%, else escalate |\n| Fare dispute > $50 | Always human review |\n| Route deviation | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80% and deviation ≤ 2km, else escalate |\n| Property damage (cleaning ≤ $50) | AI agent ruling if photo evidence is verifiable |\n| Property damage (repair > $50) | Always human review |\n| No-show / cancellation | AI agent ruling is final (fee is fixed at $5.00) |",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.2"
        },

    "policy_documents": {
      "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1": {
        "document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
        "title": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1",
        "version": "2.1",
        "effective_date": "2026-01-01",
        "source": {
          "filename": "Document 2 — Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 (Markdown).md",
          "archive_path": "sources/official/2026-10-15/policy-v2.1.md",
          "file_sha256": "827c4d2cab2d4db9e176521000b079632bbe80c20f69c3ffd0addecc8cbc8699"
        },
        "sections": {
          "1.1": {
            "title": "General Principle",
            "text": "Drivers are permitted to reroute from the GPS-recommended path in response to real-time traffic conditions, road closures, or congestion. However, the rider must be informed of any deviation.",
            "line_start": 12,
            "line_end": 14
          },
          "1.2": {
            "title": "Notification Requirement",
            "text": "- The driver **MUST** inform the rider of a route deviation via **in-app chat** or **verbally** (with the trip call recording as evidence) **before or at the point of deviation**.\n- A brief reason (e.g., \"traffic jam ahead onNicoll Highway, taking alternate route\") is sufficient.",
            "line_start": 16,
            "line_end": 19
          },
          "1.3": {
            "title": "Refund Eligibility Matrix",
            "text": "| Scenario | Rider Informed? | Deviation > 1km? | Refund |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider informed and agrees | Yes | Yes | No refund |\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider **not** informed | No | Yes | Partial refund of excess distance fare |\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider not informed | No | No (≤ 1km) | No refund (within tolerance) |\n| Driver reroutes **without** traffic justification (no evidence of congestion) | N/A | Yes | **Full refund** of excess distance fare |\n| Driver reroutes without justification, deviation ≤ 1km | N/A | No | No refund (within tolerance) |",
            "line_start": 21,
            "line_end": 29
          },
          "1.4": {
            "title": "Evidence Requirements",
            "text": "- Traffic justification is verified via **historical traffic API data** for the route segment at the trip time.\n- Route deviation distance is calculated as: `actual_route_distance − recommended_route_distance`.\n- If the driver's in-app chat or call recording confirms rider acknowledgment, the deviation is considered agreed.",
            "line_start": 31,
            "line_end": 35
          },
          "2.1": {
            "title": "Free Wait Time",
            "text": "- The driver must wait at the pickup location for a **free wait time of 5 minutes** from the scheduled pickup time.\n- After 5 minutes, the driver may cancel the trip as a \"rider no-show.\"",
            "line_start": 41,
            "line_end": 44
          },
          "2.2": {
            "title": "Cancellation Fee",
            "text": "- A **no-show cancellation fee of $5.00** is charged to the rider when the driver cancels after the free wait period.\n- The cancellation fee is transferred to the driver as compensation for time and fuel.",
            "line_start": 46,
            "line_end": 49
          },
          "2.3": {
            "title": "Driver Contact Obligation",
            "text": "Before cancelling for no-show, the driver **MUST** attempt to contact the rider with:\n\n1. **At least 1 in-app chat message**, AND\n2. **At least 1 phone call** (via the in-app calling system).\n\nIf the driver fails to meet both contact obligations, the cancellation fee is **voided** and the rider is not charged.",
            "line_start": 51,
            "line_end": 58
          },
          "2.4": {
            "title": "Driver No-Show",
            "text": "- If the driver **fails to arrive at the pickup location** within a reasonable time (defined as scheduled pickup time + 5 minutes), the rider may cancel at no charge.\n- If the driver fails to arrive **and** fails to attempt contact, the rider is eligible for a **$5.00 goodwill credit**.",
            "line_start": 60,
            "line_end": 63
          },
          "2.5": {
            "title": "Repeat No-Show Flagging",
            "text": "- If a rider accumulates **3 or more no-show cancellations within a 30-day rolling window**, the rider's account is **flagged** for review.\n- Flagged accounts are subject to:\n  - Mandatory upfront payment for future bookings.\n  - Temporary suspension pending review by the Trust & Safety team.",
            "line_start": 65,
            "line_end": 70
          },
          "3.1": {
            "title": "Upfront Quote Binding",
            "text": "- The upfront quote presented to the rider at booking is **binding at the surge multiplier in effect at quote time** (typically 1.0x in normal conditions).\n- The quoted fare includes: base fare, distance fare, time fare, booking fee, and any applicable surge.",
            "line_start": 76,
            "line_end": 79
          },
          "3.2": {
            "title": "Surge Change Notification",
            "text": "- If the surge multiplier **increases** between the time of quote and the time of trip start, the rider **MUST be notified** via an **in-app notification** before or at the point of pickup.\n- The notification must clearly state:\n  - The new surge multiplier.\n  - The revised estimated fare.\n  - An option to cancel without penalty.",
            "line_start": 81,
            "line_end": 87
          },
          "3.3": {
            "title": "Refund Eligibility",
            "text": "| Scenario | Rider Notified? | Refund |\n|---|---|---|\n| Surge increases, rider notified, rider proceeds | Yes | No refund — higher fare applies |\n| Surge increases, rider **not** notified | No | **Full refund of the surge differential** (actual fare − quoted fare) |\n| Surge decreases between quote and trip start | N/A | Lower fare applies automatically (rider benefits) |\n| Surge unchanged | N/A | Quoted fare applies |",
            "line_start": 89,
            "line_end": 96
          },
          "3.4": {
            "title": "Surge Differential Calculation",
            "text": "```\nsurge_differential = actual_fare − upfront_quote\n```\n\nWhere the difference is attributable solely to a surge multiplier change (all other fare components unchanged), the full differential is refundable if the rider was not notified.",
            "line_start": 98,
            "line_end": 104
          },
          "3.5": {
            "title": "Surge-Exempt Components",
            "text": "The following fare components are **exempt** from surge pricing and remain fixed regardless of multiplier:\n\n- Booking fee\n\nAll other components (base fare, distance fare, time fare) are subject to the surge multiplier.",
            "line_start": 106,
            "line_end": 112
          },
          "4.1": {
            "title": "Driver Claim Rights",
            "text": "Drivers may file claims for cleaning or repair fees resulting from **rider-caused damage** to the vehicle, including but not limited to:\n\n- Spills, vomiting, or food/beverage stains.\n- Physical damage to interior (seats, doors, windows).\n- Damage to exterior caused by rider behavior during boarding/alighting.",
            "line_start": 118,
            "line_end": 124
          },
          "4.2": {
            "title": "Evidence Requirements",
            "text": "| Requirement | Details |\n|---|---|\n| Photo evidence | Must be submitted **within 24 hours** of trip completion |\n| Timestamps | Photos must be automatically timestamped by the in-app camera |\n| Verifiability | Photos must be verifiable — taken through the Ryde driver app's built-in camera, not external uploads |\n| Trip association | Damage must be linked to the specific trip via GPS telemetry and trip timestamp |",
            "line_start": 126,
            "line_end": 133
          },
          "4.3": {
            "title": "Fee Structure",
            "text": "| Damage Type | Maximum Fee | Conditions |\n|---|---|---|\n| Cleaning fee | Up to **$50.00** | Photo evidence of soiling/stain; no external quote required |\n| Repair fee | Cost of repair | Requires a **written quote from a certified workshop**; quote must be submitted within 7 days |",
            "line_start": 135,
            "line_end": 140
          },
          "4.4": {
            "title": "Dispute Handling",
            "text": "- If the rider disputes the damage claim, the dispute is routed to human review.\n- The driver's photo evidence and the rider's account are both reviewed.\n- If evidence is insufficient (no timestamp, external photo, or damage not linked to trip), the claim is **rejected**.",
            "line_start": 142,
            "line_end": 146
          },
          "5.1": {
            "title": "Automatic Escalation",
            "text": "Any dispute flagged as **safety-related** is **automatically escalated to human review**. Safety-related disputes include but are not limited to:\n\n- Reckless or dangerous driving.\n- Physical or verbal harassment.\n- Assault or threat of assault.\n- Inappropriate behavior or conduct.\n- Traffic accidents during the trip.\n- Rider or driver feeling unsafe during the trip.",
            "line_start": 152,
            "line_end": 161
          },
          "5.2": {
            "title": "AI Agent Limitations",
            "text": "- AI agents (Rider Advocate, Driver Advocate, Judge) **MAY** gather evidence, summarize accounts, and prepare case files for human reviewers.\n- AI agents **CANNOT** issue rulings, determine fault, or recommend resolutions on safety incidents.\n- AI agents **MUST** flag any dispute that contains safety-related keywords or indicators for immediate human escalation, regardless of the dispute type selected by the filer.",
            "line_start": 163,
            "line_end": 167
          },
          "5.3": {
            "title": "Interim Measures",
            "text": "Upon escalation, the system may apply interim measures pending human review:\n\n- Temporary suspension of the accused party's account.\n- Prevention of new trip acceptance (for drivers) or booking (for riders).\n- These measures are lifted if the human reviewer determines no safety violation occurred.",
            "line_start": 169,
            "line_end": 175
          },
          "6.1": {
            "title": "Monetary Thresholds",
            "text": "| Dispute Value | Ruling Path | Agent Confidence Requirement |\n|---|---|---|\n| Under $10 | AI agent ruling is **final** | Any confidence level |\n| $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling with **80%+ confidence** | If confidence < 80%, escalate to human review |\n| Above $50 | **Always human review** | N/A — AI agent prepares case file only |",
            "line_start": 181,
            "line_end": 187
          },
          "6.2": {
            "title": "Category Thresholds",
            "text": "| Dispute Category | Ruling Path |\n|---|---|\n| Safety incident | **Always human review** (see Section 5) |\n| Fare dispute < $10 | AI agent ruling is final |\n| Fare dispute $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80%, else escalate |\n| Fare dispute > $50 | Always human review |\n| Route deviation | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80% and deviation ≤ 2km, else escalate |\n| Property damage (cleaning ≤ $50) | AI agent ruling if photo evidence is verifiable |\n| Property damage (repair > $50) | Always human review |\n| No-show / cancellation | AI agent ruling is final (fee is fixed at $5.00) |",
            "line_start": 189,
            "line_end": 200
          },
          "6.3": {
            "title": "Confidence Calibration",
            "text": "- Agent confidence is calculated based on: evidence completeness, policy clarity, precedent alignment, and party credibility scores.\n- If any party has a fraud flag ≥ 1, the confidence threshold is raised to 95% regardless of dispute value.",
            "line_start": 202,
            "line_end": 205
          },
          "7.1": {
            "title": "Route Deviation Without Notification",
            "text": "| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Case ID** | DISP-2026-0089 |\n| **Date** | 2026-02-12 |\n| **Dispute Type** | route_deviation |\n| **Facts** | Driver rerouted from Geylang to Orchard via Nicoll Highway due to traffic. Deviation was 1.8km beyond recommended route. Rider was not informed. GPS telemetry confirmed traffic congestion on original route. |\n| **Ruling** | Partial refund of excess distance fare. Rationale: Driver had valid traffic justification (confirmed via traffic API), but failed to notify rider per Section 1.2. Refund applies only to the excess distance fare, not the entire trip. |\n| **Refund Amount** | $3.20 |\n| **Confidence** | 91% |",
            "line_start": 213,
            "line_end": 223
          },
          "7.2": {
            "title": "Surge Pricing Without Rider Notification",
            "text": "| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Case ID** | DISP-2026-0142 |\n| **Date** | 2026-04-03 |\n| **Dispute Type** | fare_dispute |\n| **Facts** | Rider received upfront quote of $9.50 at 1.0x surge. Surge increased to 1.4x between quote and pickup. Rider was not notified. Actual fare was $12.70 — a difference of $3.20 entirely attributable to surge differential. |\n| **Ruling** | Full refund of surge differential. Rationale: Per Section 3.3, if surge increases between quote and trip start and rider is not notified, rider is eligible for full refund of the surge differential. The $3.20 difference was solely attributable to surge multiplier change. |\n| **Refund Amount** | $3.20 |\n| **Confidence** | 96% |",
            "line_start": 225,
            "line_end": 235
          },
          "7.3": {
            "title": "No-Show Cancellation Without Contact Attempt",
            "text": "| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Case ID** | DISP-2026-0211 |\n| **Date** | 2026-05-18 |\n| **Dispute Type** | cancellation_fee |\n| **Facts** | Driver arrived at pickup, waited 6 minutes, and cancelled as no-show. $5.00 fee charged to rider. Review of chat logs and call records showed the driver sent zero messages and made zero calls before cancelling. Rider arrived at the pickup point 1 minute after cancellation. |\n| **Ruling** | Cancellation fee voided. Rationale: Per Section 2.3, the driver must attempt at least 1 in-app message and 1 call before cancelling for no-show. The driver failed to meet both contact obligations. The $5.00 fee is reversed and refunded to the rider. |\n| **Refund Amount** | $5.00 |\n| **Confidence** | 98% |",
            "line_start": 237,
            "line_end": 247
          }
        }
      }
    },

    Judge 如何看双方观点

    以下为通过结构和引用检查的分析；这些检查不能证明自然语言推理正确。

    核心问题

    Whether the $5.00 no-show cancellation fee charged to the rider was contractually valid given the conflict between embedded 8-minute threshold rule P-004 and Ryde Policy v2.1 Section 2.1 5-minute wait rule, and the rider profile fraud flag requiring 95% confidence.

    乘客观点 · 部分有依据支持

    The rider correctly highlights the unresolved policy conflict between P-004 and Section 2.1, the premature cancellation if 8 minutes run from scheduled pickup, and the elevated 95% confidence requirement, though the rider's personal statement of presence is unverified.

    争议点分析

    • Applicability and reference start clock of the 8-minute no-show threshold versus the 5-minute free wait rule

      Under v2.1 Section 2.1, the driver waited 6 minutes past scheduled pickup, satisfying the 5-minute rule. However, embedded rule P-004 specifies an 8-minute threshold whose start anchor (arrival at 08:43:00 vs scheduled pickup at 08:45:00) is undefined and in conflict with v2.1.

      E-003 E-004 E-006 E-031 E-035 E-037 E-039 P-004 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.2
    • Elevation of confidence threshold due to rider fraud flag

      Under Section 6.3, because the rider profile has 1 fraud flag, the required confidence threshold is raised to 95%, which cannot be satisfied autonomously while core policy rules remain contradictory.

      E-033 P-RYDE-2.1-S6.3

    复核问题逐项处理

    • NO_SHOW_THRESHOLD_CLOCK_UNSPECIFIED · 仍待澄清

      Embedded policy P-004 does not define whether the 8-minute threshold counts from driver arrival, wait timer initiation, or scheduled pickup time, leaving the clock undefined.

      E-003 E-004 E-005 E-028 E-031 P-004 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1
    • POLICY_SOURCE_CONFLICT · 仍待澄清

      There is an unresolved contradiction between embedded cancellation policy P-004 (8-minute threshold) and standalone Policy v2.1 Section 2.1 (cancellation allowed 5 minutes after scheduled pickup). Source hierarchy is missing.

      E-003 E-006 E-031 E-037 E-039 P-004 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.2

    仍需补充的信息

    • Official determination of precedence between embedded policy P-004 and Ryde Policy v2.1 Section 2.1.
    • Authoritative definition of the anchor start event for the 8-minute no-show threshold clock in rule P-004.

    先例对照

    • P-RYDE-2.1-S7.3

      相似点：Both involve a no-show cancellation fee of $5.00 after the driver arrived at pickup and waited past the free wait window.

      差异：In precedent DISP-2026-0211, the driver sent zero messages and made zero calls, violating Section 2.3, whereas here the driver sent 4 messages and made 1 call, fully satisfying Section 2.3.

    本次绑定的政策与程序检查

    RYDE-POLICY-V2.1 · 生效 2026-01-01

    人工审核门槛

    • NO_SHOW_THRESHOLD_CLOCK_UNSPECIFIED The embedded no-show threshold has no defined start event. Section 2.1 defines free wait from scheduled pickup but does not define this separate threshold clock. P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1
    • POLICY_SOURCE_CONFLICT Embedded cancellation thresholds/fee differ from standalone v2.1 sections 2.1-2.2 (cancel after 5 free minutes from scheduled pickup; $5 fee). Source precedence is not supplied. Do not treat 5+8 as 13 or choose the favorable clock. P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.2

    逐项政策条件

    • no_show_charge · unknown

      Fixed fee requires reconciled policy, sufficient scheduled free wait, arrival and both contact attempts.

      E-001 E-003 E-004 E-005 E-006 E-007 E-008 E-017 E-018 E-019 E-020 E-021 E-022 E-023 E-024 E-025 E-026 E-027 E-028 E-029 E-030 E-031 E-032 E-035 E-036 E-037 E-038 E-039 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.4
    • free_wait · met

      Five free minutes start at scheduled pickup; exact-boundary cancellation requires clarification.

      E-003 E-006 E-035 E-036 E-037 E-039 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1
    • driver_contact · met

      At least one in-app message AND one call attempt strictly before cancellation. Missing logs alone do not prove no attempt; conflicting complete summaries require review.

      E-017 E-018 E-019 E-020 E-021 E-029 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.3
    • driver_arrival · met

      Recorded arrival event corroborates timely arrival; driver messages alone are not location evidence.

      E-004 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.4

    程序保守修正

    程序保留原输出，恢复由程序锁定的待人工／待澄清状态，对不满足来源要求的论点降低支持评级，或按逐条评价修正汇总标签，然后重新检查全部规则。转人工安排不等于问题已经解决。Fare 仅在政策条件及主依据独立成立时允许此修正；裁决与金额不变，未执行任何收费或退款。

    乘客 Advocate

    第一轮陈述

    • The rider reported waiting at the lobby pickup point at Tiong Bahru Plaza on time for 10 minutes and being unable to find the vehicle, disputing the fairness of the $5.00 no-show cancellation fee. E-002 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.4
    • The audit identifies an unresolvable source policy conflict and an unspecified clock between embedded cancellation policy P-004 (requiring an 8-minute no-show threshold) and Ryde Policy v2.1 Section 2.1 (permitting cancellation after a 5-minute free wait from scheduled pickup), precluding a definitive entitlement to charge. E-003 E-006 E-031 E-037 E-039 P-004 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.2
    • Under Ryde Policy v2.1 Section 2.1, the 5-minute free wait starts strictly at the scheduled pickup time of 08:45:00, meaning only 360 seconds (6 minutes) elapsed prior to the 08:51:00 cancellation; if embedded rule P-004's 8-minute threshold applies from scheduled time, the cancellation occurred prematurely. E-003 E-006 E-037 E-039 P-004 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1
    • Because the rider profile has 1 fraud flag, Section 6.3 elevates the agent confidence requirement to 95%, which cannot be attained in the presence of unresolved policy threshold conflicts. E-033 P-RYDE-2.1-S6.3
    • App and communication logs show the driver sent four chat messages, placed an unanswered call ringing for 22 seconds, and recorded GPS arrival at 08:43:00, which satisfies the procedural contact obligations of Section 2.3. E-001 E-013 E-017 E-018 E-019 E-020 E-021 E-026 E-029 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.3
    • While discrete GPS coordinates show the driver stopped at the plaza coordinates, periodic GPS samples alone do not prove continuous visibility or uninterrupted presence at the specific lobby entrance where the rider reported waiting. E-001 E-002 E-013 E-014 E-015 E-016
    • Clarification on the legal and contractual hierarchy between the embedded 8-minute no-show threshold (P-004) and Ryde Policy v2.1 Section 2.1 (5-minute wait from scheduled pickup).
    • Specification of the triggering start event for the embedded 8-minute no-show threshold (whether it begins at driver arrival, wait timer start, or scheduled pickup).
    • Independent verification of driver visibility or precise positioning at the specific lobby pickup bay where the rider reported waiting.

    回应对方

    • The rider reported arriving at the designated Tiong Bahru Plaza pickup lobby on time and waiting 10 minutes without locating the driver, directly disputing the fairness of the $5.00 no-show cancellation fee. E-002 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.4
    • A material policy conflict exists between embedded policy P-004 (mandating an 8-minute no-show threshold) and Ryde Policy v2.1 Section 2.1 (permitting cancellation 5 minutes after scheduled pickup); if the 8-minute threshold governs from scheduled pickup (08:45:00), the cancellation at 08:51:00 (360 seconds elapsed) was premature. E-003 E-006 E-037 E-039 P-004 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1
    • Although the driver arrived early at 08:43:00, Policy v2.1 Section 2.1 establishes that the free wait period begins strictly at the scheduled pickup time of 08:45:00, meaning early arrival cannot compress rider waiting rights. E-003 E-004 E-026 E-028 E-039 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1
    • Because an unresolvable source conflict and unspecified reference clock persist regarding the 8-minute threshold, and Section 6.3 mandates 95% confidence due to the profile fraud flag without providing a basis for resolution, the dispute cannot be summarily decided by an automated ruling. E-031 E-033 P-RYDE-2.1-S6.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S6.3
    • Opponent establishes that the driver fulfilled pre-cancellation contact rules under Section 2.3 by sending four in-app messages and placing one in-app call ringing 22 seconds before cancelling. E-017 E-018 E-019 E-020 E-021 E-029 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.3
    • Opponent shows GPS telemetry and system logs recorded the driver stationary at pickup coordinates from 08:43:00 to 08:51:00, though telemetry samples alone do not prove continuous physical visibility to the rider at the lobby entrance. E-001 E-013 E-014 E-015 E-016 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1
    • Resolution of precedence between embedded policy P-004 (8-minute no-show threshold) and Ryde Policy v2.1 Section 2.1 (5-minute free wait from scheduled pickup).
    • Explicit definition of the anchor clock for the 8-minute no-show threshold under P-004 (driver arrival at 08:43:00 vs scheduled pickup at 08:45:00).

    • Under Ryde Policy v2.1 Section 2.1, the driver waited past the required 5-minute free wait period, which began at the scheduled pickup time of 08:45:00 and ended at 08:50:00, prior to cancelling at 08:51:00 (360 seconds elapsed). E-003 E-006 E-037 E-039 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.2
    • Telemetry and system logs verify driver arrival at 08:43:00 within 10 meters of the pickup point, showing speed 0 km/h across four discrete GPS samples until cancellation at 08:51:00, establishing timely arrival under Section 2.4. E-001 E-004 E-013 E-014 E-015 E-016 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.4
    • The system wait timer and cancellation logs show a recorded wait duration of 480 seconds (8 minutes) from arrival at 08:43:00 to cancellation at 08:51:00, which triggered the embedded 8-minute no-show threshold and applied the $5.00 fee. E-005 E-006 E-008 E-022 E-028 E-030 E-031 E-035 P-001 P-002 P-004
    • The rider's statement claiming they were waiting at the lobby for 10 minutes and that the driver never arrived is directly contradicted by system-recorded arrival alerts, stationary GPS samples at the coordinates, and unanswered driver messages describing the exact car model and license plate. E-001 E-002 E-018 E-026 E-027 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.4
    • While the opponent argues that the embedded 8-minute threshold P-004 creates an unresolvable source conflict requiring human review, the driver demonstrably fulfilled the standalone Ryde Policy v2.1 Section 2.1 rule (5 minutes from scheduled time) and also satisfied an 8-minute elapsed wait from recorded arrival (08:43:00 to 08:51:00). E-004 E-006 E-031 E-035 E-037 E-039 P-004 P-RYDE-2.1-S2.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S6.3
    • Clarification on source precedence between embedded cancellation policy P-004 (8-minute threshold) and standalone Ryde Policy v2.1 Section 2.1 (5-minute wait from scheduled pickup).
    • Explicit definition of the triggering start clock for embedded policy rule P-004 (whether measured from driver arrival or scheduled pickup time).

    来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §2.2 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

    [
  {
    "path": "/sections/2.2",

      "text": "- A **no-show cancellation fee of $5.00** is charged to the rider when the driver cancels after the free wait period.\n- The cancellation fee is transferred to the driver as compensation for time and fuel.",
      "line_start": 46,

    }

    P-RYDE-2.1-S2.3 Section 2.3: Driver Contact Obligation

    来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §2.3 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

    [
  {
    "path": "/sections/2.3",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Driver Contact Obligation",
      "text": "Before cancelling for no-show, the driver **MUST** attempt to contact the rider with:\n\n1. **At least 1 in-app chat message**, AND\n2. **At least 1 phone call** (via the in-app calling system).\n\nIf the driver fails to meet both contact obligations, the cancellation fee is **voided** and the rider is not charged.",
      "line_start": 51,
      "line_end": 58
    }
  }
]
    P-RYDE-2.1-S2.4 Section 2.4: Driver No-Show

    来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §2.4 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

    [
  {
    "path": "/sections/2.4",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Driver No-Show",
      "text": "- If the driver **fails to arrive at the pickup location** within a reasonable time (defined as scheduled pickup time + 5 minutes), the rider may cancel at no charge.\n- If the driver fails to arrive **and** fails to attempt contact, the rider is eligible for a **$5.00 goodwill credit**.",
      "line_start": 60,
      "line_end": 63
    }
  }
]
    P-RYDE-2.1-S2.5 Section 2.5: Repeat No-Show Flagging

    来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §2.5 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

    [
  {
    "path": "/sections/2.5",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Repeat No-Show Flagging",
      "text": "- If a rider accumulates **3 or more no-show cancellations within a 30-day rolling window**, the rider's account is **flagged** for review.\n- Flagged accounts are subject to:\n  - Mandatory upfront payment for future bookings.\n  - Temporary suspension pending review by the Trust & Safety team.",
      "line_start": 65,
      "line_end": 70
    }
  }
]
    P-RYDE-2.1-S5.1 Section 5.1: Automatic Escalation

    来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.1 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

    [
  {
    "path": "/sections/5.1",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Automatic Escalation",
      "text": "Any dispute flagged as **safety-related** is **automatically escalated to human review**. Safety-related disputes include but are not limited to:\n\n- Reckless or dangerous driving.\n- Physical or verbal harassment.\n- Assault or threat of assault.\n- Inappropriate behavior or conduct.\n- Traffic accidents during the trip.\n- Rider or driver feeling unsafe during the trip.",
      "line_start": 152,
      "line_end": 161
    }
  }
]
    P-RYDE-2.1-S5.2 Section 5.2: AI Agent Limitations

    来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.2 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

    [
  {
    "path": "/sections/5.2",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "AI Agent Limitations",
      "text": "- AI agents (Rider Advocate, Driver Advocate, Judge) **MAY** gather evidence, summarize accounts, and prepare case files for human reviewers.\n- AI agents **CANNOT** issue rulings, determine fault, or recommend resolutions on safety incidents.\n- AI agents **MUST** flag any dispute that contains safety-related keywords or indicators for immediate human escalation, regardless of the dispute type selected by the filer.",
      "line_start": 163,
      "line_end": 167
    }
  }
]

    来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.3 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

  {
    "path": "/sections/5.3",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Interim Measures",
      "text": "Upon escalation, the system may apply interim measures pending human review:\n\n- Temporary suspension of the accused party's account.\n- Prevention of new trip acceptance (for drivers) or booking (for riders).\n- These measures are lifted if the human reviewer determines no safety violation occurred.",

    P-RYDE-2.1-S6.1 Section 6.1: Monetary Thresholds

    来源：Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.1 · 类型：organizer_policy_document

    [
  {
    "path": "/sections/6.1",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Monetary Thresholds",
      "text": "| Dispute Value | Ruling Path | Agent Confidence Requirement |\n|---|---|---|\n| Under $10 | AI agent ruling is **final** | Any confidence level |\n| $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling with **80%+ confidence** | If confidence < 80%, escalate to human review |\n| Above $50 | **Always human review** | N/A — AI agent prepares case file only |",
      "line_start": 181,
      "line_end": 187
    }
  }

    [
  {
    "path": "/sections/6.2",
    "source_document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
    "value": {
      "title": "Category Thresholds",
      "text": "| Dispute Category | Ruling Path |\n|---|---|\n| Safety incident | **Always human review** (see Section 5) |\n| Fare dispute < $10 | AI agent ruling is final |\n| Fare dispute $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80%, else escalate |\n| Fare dispute > $50 | Always human review |\n| Route deviation | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80% and deviation ≤ 2km, else escalate |\n| Property damage (cleaning ≤ $50) | AI agent ruling if photo evidence is verifiable |\n| Property damage (repair > $50) | Always human review |\n| No-show / cancellation | AI agent ruling is final (fee is fixed at $5.00) |",
      "line_start": 189,

    }
  }

          "rule": "Section 2.3: Driver Contact Obligation\nBefore cancelling for no-show, the driver **MUST** attempt to contact the rider with:\n\n1. **At least 1 in-app chat message**, AND\n2. **At least 1 phone call** (via the in-app calling system).\n\nIf the driver fails to meet both contact obligations, the cancellation fee is **voided** and the rider is not charged.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §2.3"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S2.4",
          "rule": "Section 2.4: Driver No-Show\n- If the driver **fails to arrive at the pickup location** within a reasonable time (defined as scheduled pickup time + 5 minutes), the rider may cancel at no charge.\n- If the driver fails to arrive **and** fails to attempt contact, the rider is eligible for a **$5.00 goodwill credit**.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §2.4"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S2.5",
          "rule": "Section 2.5: Repeat No-Show Flagging\n- If a rider accumulates **3 or more no-show cancellations within a 30-day rolling window**, the rider's account is **flagged** for review.\n- Flagged accounts are subject to:\n  - Mandatory upfront payment for future bookings.\n  - Temporary suspension pending review by the Trust & Safety team.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §2.5"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S5.1",
          "rule": "Section 5.1: Automatic Escalation\nAny dispute flagged as **safety-related** is **automatically escalated to human review**. Safety-related disputes include but are not limited to:\n\n- Reckless or dangerous driving.\n- Physical or verbal harassment.\n- Assault or threat of assault.\n- Inappropriate behavior or conduct.\n- Traffic accidents during the trip.\n- Rider or driver feeling unsafe during the trip.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.1"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S5.2",
          "rule": "Section 5.2: AI Agent Limitations\n- AI agents (Rider Advocate, Driver Advocate, Judge) **MAY** gather evidence, summarize accounts, and prepare case files for human reviewers.\n- AI agents **CANNOT** issue rulings, determine fault, or recommend resolutions on safety incidents.\n- AI agents **MUST** flag any dispute that contains safety-related keywords or indicators for immediate human escalation, regardless of the dispute type selected by the filer.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.2"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S5.3",
          "rule": "Section 5.3: Interim Measures\nUpon escalation, the system may apply interim measures pending human review:\n\n- Temporary suspension of the accused party's account.\n- Prevention of new trip acceptance (for drivers) or booking (for riders).\n- These measures are lifted if the human reviewer determines no safety violation occurred.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §5.3"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S6.1",
          "rule": "Section 6.1: Monetary Thresholds\n| Dispute Value | Ruling Path | Agent Confidence Requirement |\n|---|---|---|\n| Under $10 | AI agent ruling is **final** | Any confidence level |\n| $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling with **80%+ confidence** | If confidence < 80%, escalate to human review |\n| Above $50 | **Always human review** | N/A — AI agent prepares case file only |",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.1"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S6.2",
          "rule": "Section 6.2: Category Thresholds\n| Dispute Category | Ruling Path |\n|---|---|\n| Safety incident | **Always human review** (see Section 5) |\n| Fare dispute < $10 | AI agent ruling is final |\n| Fare dispute $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80%, else escalate |\n| Fare dispute > $50 | Always human review |\n| Route deviation | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80% and deviation ≤ 2km, else escalate |\n| Property damage (cleaning ≤ $50) | AI agent ruling if photo evidence is verifiable |\n| Property damage (repair > $50) | Always human review |\n| No-show / cancellation | AI agent ruling is final (fee is fixed at $5.00) |",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.2"
        },
        {
          "policy_id": "P-RYDE-2.1-S6.3",
          "rule": "Section 6.3: Confidence Calibration\n- Agent confidence is calculated based on: evidence completeness, policy clarity, precedent alignment, and party credibility scores.\n- If any party has a fraud flag ≥ 1, the confidence threshold is raised to 95% regardless of dispute value.",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §6.3"
        },
        {

The $5.00 fee is reversed and refunded to the rider. |\n| **Refund Amount** | $5.00 |\n| **Confidence** | 98% |",
          "source": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 §7.3"
        }
      ]

    "policy_documents": {
      "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1": {
        "document_id": "RYDE-POLICY-V2.1",
        "title": "Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1",
        "version": "2.1",
        "effective_date": "2026-01-01",
        "source": {
          "filename": "Document 2 — Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 (Markdown).md",
          "archive_path": "sources/official/2026-10-15/policy-v2.1.md",
          "file_sha256": "827c4d2cab2d4db9e176521000b079632bbe80c20f69c3ffd0addecc8cbc8699"
        },
        "sections": {
          "1.1": {
            "title": "General Principle",
            "text": "Drivers are permitted to reroute from the GPS-recommended path in response to real-time traffic conditions, road closures, or congestion. However, the rider must be informed of any deviation.",
            "line_start": 12,
            "line_end": 14
          },
          "1.2": {
            "title": "Notification Requirement",
            "text": "- The driver **MUST** inform the rider of a route deviation via **in-app chat** or **verbally** (with the trip call recording as evidence) **before or at the point of deviation**.\n- A brief reason (e.g., \"traffic jam ahead onNicoll Highway, taking alternate route\") is sufficient.",
            "line_start": 16,
            "line_end": 19
          },
          "1.3": {
            "title": "Refund Eligibility Matrix",
            "text": "| Scenario | Rider Informed? | Deviation > 1km? | Refund |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider informed and agrees | Yes | Yes | No refund |\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider **not** informed | No | Yes | Partial refund of excess distance fare |\n| Driver reroutes for traffic, rider not informed | No | No (≤ 1km) | No refund (within tolerance) |\n| Driver reroutes **without** traffic justification (no evidence of congestion) | N/A | Yes | **Full refund** of excess distance fare |\n| Driver reroutes without justification, deviation ≤ 1km | N/A | No | No refund (within tolerance) |",
            "line_start": 21,
            "line_end": 29
          },
          "1.4": {
            "title": "Evidence Requirements",
            "text": "- Traffic justification is verified via **historical traffic API data** for the route segment at the trip time.\n- Route deviation distance is calculated as: `actual_route_distance − recommended_route_distance`.\n- If the driver's in-app chat or call recording confirms rider acknowledgment, the deviation is considered agreed.",
            "line_start": 31,
            "line_end": 35
          },
          "2.1": {
            "title": "Free Wait Time",
            "text": "- The driver must wait at the pickup location for a **free wait time of 5 minutes** from the scheduled pickup time.\n- After 5 minutes, the driver may cancel the trip as a \"rider no-show.\"",
            "line_start": 41,
            "line_end": 44
          },
          "2.2": {
            "title": "Cancellation Fee",
            "text": "- A **no-show cancellation fee of $5.00** is charged to the rider when the driver cancels after the free wait period.\n- The cancellation fee is transferred to the driver as compensation for time and fuel.",
            "line_start": 46,
            "line_end": 49
          },
          "2.3": {
            "title": "Driver Contact Obligation",
            "text": "Before cancelling for no-show, the driver **MUST** attempt to contact the rider with:\n\n1. **At least 1 in-app chat message**, AND\n2. **At least 1 phone call** (via the in-app calling system).\n\nIf the driver fails to meet both contact obligations, the cancellation fee is **voided** and the rider is not charged.",
            "line_start": 51,
            "line_end": 58
          },
          "2.4": {
            "title": "Driver No-Show",
            "text": "- If the driver **fails to arrive at the pickup location** within a reasonable time (defined as scheduled pickup time + 5 minutes), the rider may cancel at no charge.\n- If the driver fails to arrive **and** fails to attempt contact, the rider is eligible for a **$5.00 goodwill credit**.",
            "line_start": 60,
            "line_end": 63
          },
          "2.5": {
            "title": "Repeat No-Show Flagging",
            "text": "- If a rider accumulates **3 or more no-show cancellations within a 30-day rolling window**, the rider's account is **flagged** for review.\n- Flagged accounts are subject to:\n  - Mandatory upfront payment for future bookings.\n  - Temporary suspension pending review by the Trust & Safety team.",
            "line_start": 65,
            "line_end": 70
          },
          "3.1": {
            "title": "Upfront Quote Binding",
            "text": "- The upfront quote presented to the rider at booking is **binding at the surge multiplier in effect at quote time** (typically 1.0x in normal conditions).\n- The quoted fare includes: base fare, distance fare, time fare, booking fee, and any applicable surge.",
            "line_start": 76,
            "line_end": 79
          },
          "3.2": {
            "title": "Surge Change Notification",
            "text": "- If the surge multiplier **increases** between the time of quote and the time of trip start, the rider **MUST be notified** via an **in-app notification** before or at the point of pickup.\n- The notification must clearly state:\n  - The new surge multiplier.\n  - The revised estimated fare.\n  - An option to cancel without penalty.",
            "line_start": 81,
            "line_end": 87
          },
          "3.3": {
            "title": "Refund Eligibility",
            "text": "| Scenario | Rider Notified? | Refund |\n|---|---|---|\n| Surge increases, rider notified, rider proceeds | Yes | No refund — higher fare applies |\n| Surge increases, rider **not** notified | No | **Full refund of the surge differential** (actual fare − quoted fare) |\n| Surge decreases between quote and trip start | N/A | Lower fare applies automatically (rider benefits) |\n| Surge unchanged | N/A | Quoted fare applies |",
            "line_start": 89,
            "line_end": 96
          },
          "3.4": {
            "title": "Surge Differential Calculation",
            "text": "```\nsurge_differential = actual_fare − upfront_quote\n```\n\nWhere the difference is attributable solely to a surge multiplier change (all other fare components unchanged), the full differential is refundable if the rider was not notified.",
            "line_start": 98,
            "line_end": 104
          },
          "3.5": {
            "title": "Surge-Exempt Components",
            "text": "The following fare components are **exempt** from surge pricing and remain fixed regardless of multiplier:\n\n- Booking fee\n\nAll other components (base fare, distance fare, time fare) are subject to the surge multiplier.",
            "line_start": 106,
            "line_end": 112
          },
          "4.1": {
            "title": "Driver Claim Rights",
            "text": "Drivers may file claims for cleaning or repair fees resulting from **rider-caused damage** to the vehicle, including but not limited to:\n\n- Spills, vomiting, or food/beverage stains.\n- Physical damage to interior (seats, doors, windows).\n- Damage to exterior caused by rider behavior during boarding/alighting.",
            "line_start": 118,
            "line_end": 124
          },
          "4.2": {
            "title": "Evidence Requirements",
            "text": "| Requirement | Details |\n|---|---|\n| Photo evidence | Must be submitted **within 24 hours** of trip completion |\n| Timestamps | Photos must be automatically timestamped by the in-app camera |\n| Verifiability | Photos must be verifiable — taken through the Ryde driver app's built-in camera, not external uploads |\n| Trip association | Damage must be linked to the specific trip via GPS telemetry and trip timestamp |",
            "line_start": 126,
            "line_end": 133
          },
          "4.3": {
            "title": "Fee Structure",
            "text": "| Damage Type | Maximum Fee | Conditions |\n|---|---|---|\n| Cleaning fee | Up to **$50.00** | Photo evidence of soiling/stain; no external quote required |\n| Repair fee | Cost of repair | Requires a **written quote from a certified workshop**; quote must be submitted within 7 days |",
            "line_start": 135,
            "line_end": 140
          },
          "4.4": {
            "title": "Dispute Handling",
            "text": "- If the rider disputes the damage claim, the dispute is routed to human review.\n- The driver's photo evidence and the rider's account are both reviewed.\n- If evidence is insufficient (no timestamp, external photo, or damage not linked to trip), the claim is **rejected**.",
            "line_start": 142,
            "line_end": 146
          },
          "5.1": {
            "title": "Automatic Escalation",
            "text": "Any dispute flagged as **safety-related** is **automatically escalated to human review**. Safety-related disputes include but are not limited to:\n\n- Reckless or dangerous driving.\n- Physical or verbal harassment.\n- Assault or threat of assault.\n- Inappropriate behavior or conduct.\n- Traffic accidents during the trip.\n- Rider or driver feeling unsafe during the trip.",
            "line_start": 152,
            "line_end": 161
          },
          "5.2": {
            "title": "AI Agent Limitations",
            "text": "- AI agents (Rider Advocate, Driver Advocate, Judge) **MAY** gather evidence, summarize accounts, and prepare case files for human reviewers.\n- AI agents **CANNOT** issue rulings, determine fault, or recommend resolutions on safety incidents.\n- AI agents **MUST** flag any dispute that contains safety-related keywords or indicators for immediate human escalation, regardless of the dispute type selected by the filer.",
            "line_start": 163,
            "line_end": 167
          },
          "5.3": {
            "title": "Interim Measures",
            "text": "Upon escalation, the system may apply interim measures pending human review:\n\n- Temporary suspension of the accused party's account.\n- Prevention of new trip acceptance (for drivers) or booking (for riders).\n- These measures are lifted if the human reviewer determines no safety violation occurred.",
            "line_start": 169,
            "line_end": 175
          },
          "6.1": {
            "title": "Monetary Thresholds",
            "text": "| Dispute Value | Ruling Path | Agent Confidence Requirement |\n|---|---|---|\n| Under $10 | AI agent ruling is **final** | Any confidence level |\n| $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling with **80%+ confidence** | If confidence < 80%, escalate to human review |\n| Above $50 | **Always human review** | N/A — AI agent prepares case file only |",
            "line_start": 181,
            "line_end": 187
          },
          "6.2": {
            "title": "Category Thresholds",
            "text": "| Dispute Category | Ruling Path |\n|---|---|\n| Safety incident | **Always human review** (see Section 5) |\n| Fare dispute < $10 | AI agent ruling is final |\n| Fare dispute $10 – $50 | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80%, else escalate |\n| Fare dispute > $50 | Always human review |\n| Route deviation | AI agent ruling if confidence ≥ 80% and deviation ≤ 2km, else escalate |\n| Property damage (cleaning ≤ $50) | AI agent ruling if photo evidence is verifiable |\n| Property damage (repair > $50) | Always human review |\n| No-show / cancellation | AI agent ruling is final (fee is fixed at $5.00) |",
            "line_start": 189,
            "line_end": 200
          },
          "6.3": {
            "title": "Confidence Calibration",
            "text": "- Agent confidence is calculated based on: evidence completeness, policy clarity, precedent alignment, and party credibility scores.\n- If any party has a fraud flag ≥ 1, the confidence threshold is raised to 95% regardless of dispute value.",
            "line_start": 202,
            "line_end": 205
          },
          "7.1": {
            "title": "Route Deviation Without Notification",
            "text": "| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Case ID** | DISP-2026-0089 |\n| **Date** | 2026-02-12 |\n| **Dispute Type** | route_deviation |\n| **Facts** | Driver rerouted from Geylang to Orchard via Nicoll Highway due to traffic. Deviation was 1.8km beyond recommended route. Rider was not informed. GPS telemetry confirmed traffic congestion on original route. |\n| **Ruling** | Partial refund of excess distance fare. Rationale: Driver had valid traffic justification (confirmed via traffic API), but failed to notify rider per Section 1.2. Refund applies only to the excess distance fare, not the entire trip. |\n| **Refund Amount** | $3.20 |\n| **Confidence** | 91% |",
            "line_start": 213,
            "line_end": 223
          },
          "7.2": {
            "title": "Surge Pricing Without Rider Notification",

        裁决关键条件

        • fare_charge · 不满足

          The upfront quote is binding under Section 3.1; because surge notice was omitted, charging the higher surge fare is invalid under Section 3.3, entitling the rider to a refund of the surge differential.

          E-001 E-015 E-016 E-017 E-018 E-019 E-020 E-021 E-022 E-023 E-024 E-025 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.5
        • surge_components · 满足

          The entire fare difference of $4.50 is attributable solely to the surge multiplier change (1.0x to 1.5x) on the surgeable subtotal of $9.00, with exempt components unchanged.

          E-015 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.5
        • surge_timing · 满足

          The surge window was activated at 21:04:30, which occurred prior to the trip start at 21:05:00.

          E-017 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3
        • surge_notice · 不满足

          The surge pricing log explicitly confirms rider_notified=false with no notification timestamp or method, violating mandatory notification requirements under Section 3.2.

          E-017 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3

        争议点分析

        • Entitlement to refund of the SGD 4.50 surge difference

          Per Section 3.2 and Section 3.3, dynamic surge increases prior to pickup require mandatory in-app notification; absence of notification entitles the rider to a full refund of the surge differential, while retaining the quoted base fare for the completed trip.

          E-015 E-021 E-022 E-024 E-025 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4

        复核问题逐项处理

          仍需补充的信息

          • 本次分析未列出额外缺失信息。

          先例对照

          • P-RYDE-2.1-S7.2

            相似点：Both cases involve a surge multiplier increase occurring between booking quote and pickup where the rider was not notified, resulting in an unnotified fare difference attributable entirely to surge.

            差异：In precedent DISP-2026-0142 the quote was $9.50 surging to 1.4x ($12.70, $3.20 difference), whereas here the quote was $12.00 surging to 1.5x ($16.50, $4.50 difference).

          规则来源

          每条政策保留案卷中的来源标签；团队程序检查不代表平台收费政策。

            逐项政策条件

            • fare_charge · not_met

              Apply the binding quote and surge-only notification rule, not the entire-trip refund.

              E-001 E-015 E-016 E-017 E-018 E-019 E-020 E-021 E-022 E-023 E-024 E-025 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.5
            • surge_components · met

              Difference must be attributable solely to surge, with unchanged surgeable subtotal and exempt components.

              E-015 E-026 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.1 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.4 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.5
            • surge_timing · met

              Increased surge must have been activated by pickup; absence of an activation record remains unknown.

              E-017 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3
            • surge_notice · not_met

              System log explicitly records no notice; this is not an inference from absent chat.

              E-017 E-024 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.2 P-RYDE-2.1-S3.3

            • Although the rider completed the 13-minute trip to Marina Bay Sands without recorded mid-trip objection, proceeding with the ride does not waive the refund because policy conditions retaining the higher fare strictly on the rider having received required prior notification.
